name: Rabbids Go Home
summary: Your job is to run the gauntlet of the irate human-folk, collect as much stuff as you can and watch that pile grow ever closer to the moon. This will entail negotiating 15 levels and solving 150 brain-teasing puzzles, all set in locales as exotic as Las Vegas, Miami and an enormous rubbish dump. You’ll need to think like a Rabbid as you devise chain reactions to achieve your goal of getting your paws on all that lovely stuff. It’s not all cerebral stuff though – these are Rabbids after all - and you’ll also need speedy stylus skills and Rabbid reactions to keep up with the action.
